Markets carry risk, including the risk of total loss. Past performance does not predict future results. Before acting on anything you read here, verify it against primary sources and consider speaking with a licensed financial professional who knows your situation.

## Positions

The author may hold positions in securities discussed on this site. No position is disclosed unless it is stated in the piece itself, and any position may change at any time without notice or an update to published work.

## Accuracy and sources

Figures are drawn from public sources and third-party data at the time of writing. They may be delayed, revised, or wrong. Content is published as of its date and is not updated as circumstances change.

Reading this site, subscribing to the newsletter, or contacting the author creates no advisory, fiduciary, or professional relationship of any kind.
